text:
Isha Patel: Heads up — PraxisAI onboarding: p50 for chat gen is around 420ms on hosted and token spend is trending 28% above forecast. Thinking proactive optimization: int8 quant swap for their most common route + a latency-first routing policy during PST peaks. Proposal: small canary (5% -> 25% over 24h) with automatic rollback on eval/latency regressions. Thoughts?

Carlos Rivera: I like the canary approach. Can we add prefix/KV caching first though? That might reduce tokens and latency without touching model weights. If caching gives ~10% improvement, maybe we can avoid swapping models.

Maya Chen: From enablement — PraxisAI is OK with a model swap but they require accuracy within 1% of their eval set. They'll provide the eval prompts today. They also want a joint runbook before we flip any traffic.

Isha Patel: Good constraints. Plan A: try caching + routing tweak for 48h. If improvement <10% or cost still too high, Plan B: int8 canary. Canary config I'm proposing (high level):

```
{
  "model": "mpt-7b",
  "quant": "int8",
  "canary": {"start_pct": 5, "step_pct": 5, "max_pct": 25, "step_duration_hours": 6},
  "rollback_conditions": ["p50_latency_increase>10%","eval_accuracy_drop>1%","error_rate_increase>0.5%"],
  "routing_policy": {"type": "latency_priority","slo_ms": 300,"fallback_model": "mpt-7b-fp16"},
  "monitoring_metrics": ["p50_latency","p95_latency","token_cost","eval_accuracy","errors"]
}
```

Carlos Rivera: Nice. Ops checklist requests: make sure we have a dedicated pool available for the canary traffic and autoscale set to avoid cold starts. Also add a temporary quota for PraxisAI's route to cap cost during testing. @Deploy Bot can you preflight capacity? :pray:

Deploy Bot: preflight-check: capacity pool available (dedicated-gpu-pool-3), estimated headroom 12%, autoscale policy present. Created temporary quota praxisai-test-quant with monthly cap $3k. Canary schedule windows: 2026-04-05T16:00Z start (pending approvals).

Maya Chen: I'll schedule a 30-min sync with PraxisAI for 4/5 09:00 PT to walk the runbook and get their eval set. I'll also ask them to pin the promptset & expected metrics.

Isha Patel: I'll draft the runbook and the rollback playbook. Carlos — can you drop the routing CLI we should run for the latency-first path?

Carlos Rivera: Sure — example command: `redwood routes set --team praxisai --route /chat --policy latency:300 --fallback mpt-7b-fp16 --canary 5,5,25`

Isha Patel: Perfect. I'll post the runbook in the customer folder and ping PraxisAI. Thanks team — will update this thread once they send the eval set. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Adding note — capture customer sentiment in renewal tracker (they're mid-Q coming up). If cost doesn't improve, flag for renewal risk outreach.

Isha Patel: Noted. I'll add a renewal-risk tag to the account and set a reminder for a health check two weeks after the canary completes.

Carlos Rivera: +1. Low-effort ask: include a short A/B prompt set so we can run automatic evals during canary.

Maya Chen: Will do.
